training_sources: Only permitted labelled rows/forms and public lexicon. Rich cache rebuilt per CV fold, shared-validation fit pool and full outer train. Pending labels blank/forms absent.
feature_asset_provenance: Fresh rich features preserve old features exactly; true-anchor summaries use permitted true rows only, excluding own-page anchors on training features. Vectorizers, selectors, scaling and reductions fit on training only.

fixed_classifier.note: Hyperparameters frozen from previous training-side CV, never retuned in this feature comparison. Reusing those CV folds makes feature CV scores selection diagnostics, not unbiased estimates.

cv_policy: Exact previous shared-fit-pool CV fold IDs; stratified 3-fold seed42 for stratified/checker, whole-date expanding forward folds for temporal. Feature winner by mean fixed050 macro F1, ties by declared config order. Freeze before shared validation/outer test.

confidence.semantics: Uncalibrated winning-class GB probability; native unsure retained, below .5 abstains
confidence.calibration: Nested training-only parse-score isotonic; no output calibration

leakage_audit.detail: Separate cache builders receive sanitized runtime and train-only forms. CV worker receives only fit-pool labels. Prediction worker receives only sanitized caches. Evaluator retains shared-validation and outer answers. No OS filesystem isolation.

model_asset_reason: Models fitted in memory; split caches, predictions and hashes saved.

stratified.selection: mean CV macro F1 after fixed050; ties by declared config order

temporal.selection: mean CV macro F1 after fixed050; ties by declared config order

checker.selection: mean CV macro F1 after fixed050; ties by declared config order
